primary_conditions.native_scope: Library Checkerのcpp条件。AtCoderへこの条件を外挿しない。

method.construction: 隣接リストの生成を除き、プロセス内の最初のLCA構築を計時。確保と前処理を含み、破棄・照会生成・入出力を含めない。各候補15回は毎回新プロセス。
method.query: 乱択した頂点番号・任意根の同一グラフ、同一順序の262144照会。warmup1周の後、2周を1sampleとして5sample、1照会nsへ換算。各新プロセス内の中央値を取り、15プロセスの中央値を用いる。checksum全一致。
method.break_even: (新構築ns-旧構築ns)/(旧1照会ns-新1照会ns)。分母<=0は回収不能(null)。各時間の中央値からの概算でありオンラインの保証値ではない。
method.graph_distribution: 親を一様に過去の論理頂点から選ぶ木、二分木、17頂点ごとに辺を省く森。全頂点番号を乱択置換し、置換後の根を指定。入力番号の大小をアルゴリズムへ利用しない。
method.mode_ancestor: 頂点と深さの半分だけ上った祖先。
method.warm_build_exploration: 別の同一プロセス内反復構築ではallocator/cacheで構築時間と分岐点が大きく変わったため、単発構築の回答には使わない。
method.verification_main: 今回の計時専用ドライバは分析用。Verify mainは変更せず、main全体の性能と照会単体を混同しない。

fixed_main_interpretation: 9回でもbaseline/controlの同一コード間で数%以上の揺れがあり、一部条件は追加検証負荷とも重なった。単独照会と異なり全体の一律改善を主張しない。採否と損益分岐の主根拠は新プロセスでの構築と独立照会。

tradeoff_summary.single_tree_random_queries_gcc_native: N=1万:約1万照会、N=10万:約9万照会、N=50万:約56〜61万照会で構築増を回収。概ねQがN前後。
tradeoff_summary.forest_500000: 今回の多成分を含む乱択照会では約181万照会、約3.6N。
tradeoff_summary.ancestor_same_root: 今回の新方式はこれらの照会が遅い。これだけなら構築増は回収できない。混合時は各照会の増減を重み付けする。

uniform_rmq.recommendation: reject uniform shallow-tree RMQ extension for current baseline
proof: All candidates use only baseline own iterative DFS entries and parents; original vertex labels are never compared for ancestral order.

For a,b ordered by own DFS entry with neither ancestor of the other, the minimum parent DFS entry in (entry(a),entry(b)] is exactly entry(lca(a,b)). The existing monotonic masks and sparse table produce that minimum.

Packed key is (uint64_t(parentDFS)<<32)|uint32_t(parentVertex). Each DFS entry corresponds to exactly one vertex, hence different low halves cannot reorder equal DFS keys; minimum returns original lca vertex directly.

RMQ flag candidate retains the original shallow binary ancestor table and marks use_ladder_ only when that ladder has actually been built. Deep paths remain baseline algorithm. Forest component check precedes range query; root packed key includes own DFS entry and actual component root.

All construction is in replacement object before swap. Immutable shared query data remains safe under copy, independent up/Vertex state preserved, and use_ladder_ participates in copy/swap/move via swap. Exception ownership remains RAII.

Packed prefix is 12N bytes, same as baseline DFS+keys+masks prefix. Packed sparse table uses8 bytes per entry vs4; maximum-count limit and multiplication bounds checked prior to resize. uint32 vertex and DFS bounds remain baseline size guards.
performance_conclusion: API-only standard O2 get is 8-20% faster for representative shallow trees, while kth is preserved with explicit use_ladder_ flag.
All-RMQ plus Ladder instead of up table costs up to90% in kth and up to70% construction in screening, so not suitable.

Uniform RMQ plus unchanged shallow up table costs16-37% construction; official same-main native GCC median9-run random inputs slow5-6%, binary input slow3-14%. Control close on random and binary02; binary00 control4.5% slower indicates residual drift, still candidates worse.
Packed representation does not reverse conclusion: extra64-bit sparse table memory and comparisons offset the removed DFS inverse lookup.
The last three packed main deep-tree cases may overlap correctness runs on CPU20 and are advisory; first four shallow official cases conclusively reject uniform extension.
uniform_rmq.source_status: Frozen baseline/source/driver/IO unchanged; only own /tmp candidates and reports written.

validation.scope: Shared CSR preprocessing only;generic API/label validation also exercises candidate query engines
reviewed_invariants: edge_count remains <=INT_MAX;edge_limit-edge_count cannot underflow before each size check. Every stored offset and degree fits int.
CSR read occurs before Vertex.entry/end are overwritten. DFS discovery touches only depth/component/parent,so undispatched vertices retain offset/degree.
Each discovered vertex is marked by depth before push,so it is popped once;entry/end slots are not needed as CSR metadata afterward.
On aggregate size overflow,fits=false prevents allocation and chooses original graph adjacency;partially written entry/end metadata is ignored and overwritten by traversal.
All-zero edge_count leaves adjacency null,correctly selecting original empty adjacency lists. Zero-degree vertices in nonempty CSR can hold one-past pointers without dereferencing.
CSR allocation/copy completes before DFS;int copy cannot throw. Allocation failures unwind unique_ptr and replacement-build preserves target state.
Input root validation precedes storage;endpoint/cycle/parallel checks remain in traversal and are removed only under SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS.
The new full edge copy is preprocessing for locality,not a validation-only scan. Adjacency symmetry remains the documented precondition.
limitations: Aggregate edge_count>INT_MAX fallback is statically reviewed rather than allocated in tests.
Performance and memory peak are measured by parent;validation does not claim speed gains.
LeakSanitizer disabled under ptrace;failure injection requires live_delta0.
